summary: Sets out requirements for extending the IETF Datatracker so ordinary community members and IETF leaders can easily follow the progress of the Internet-Drafts and RFCs they care about. It is an informational requirements document rather than a standard.

eli5.summary: Imagine a website that lets you follow your favorite documents like a mail-tracking page follows a package. This note describes what that tracking features should do so people can see how each document is moving along.
